entry.title: A useful question before another grand platform
entry.content: Can a stranger find one useful, checkable idea, keep a copy, disagree and leave? Access to this example is free. No account is required.
entry.summary: Synthetic demonstration version: Original synthetic demonstration text.

entry.title: Corrections are part of the product
entry.content: Readers can compare a previous version with this one and prepare a proposed correction locally. Preparing feedback is not sending it, and feedback never silently edits the source.
entry.summary: Synthetic demonstration version: Added inspectable versions and a non-transmitting feedback example.

entry.title: The commons stays free; support stays voluntary
entry.content: A source-linked work may be shared freely where rights permit. Optional donations could support contributors, accessibility, preservation and independent checking, with allocations disclosed before solicitation. This demo has no donation link and accepts no money.
entry.summary: Synthetic demonstration version: Separated free access and transparent proposed support from payment and recognition authority.
